free_tier.stated: No published per-user or per-file quota anywhere in the docs. The platform hosts the files itself ('upload the data file directly to the HDX platform'), S3-backed. Aggregate catalog is 28,359 datasets and growing at organisational pace.

egress.terms: Unmetered public download. Direct GET on /dataset/<slug>/resource/<id>/download/<file>; no egress counter, no rate card, no CDN token. Files are anonymous to read. No login to download.

record.interface_detail: CKAN 2.x action API (package_search / package_create / resource_create) plus the `hdx-python-api` wrapper, which is the documented write path.
record.tooling: curl + API token, or `pip install hdx-python-api`. Write operations need an API token from the user profile; token is per-user, free, issued on signup.
record.chaining: CKAN resource_create accepts a URL as well as a local file, so HDX can act as a metadata+mirror layer over another host. Public download URLs are stable and content-addressable by resource id. Reasonable as a serving tier.
record.limits_note: write-gated: you must belong to an HDX organisation with publishing rights. Any registered user may REQUEST a new organisation (`/org/request/new`) and the request is human-reviewed by OCHA. So the gate is editorial approval, not identity or payment.
record.reliability_note: UN-operated, 10+ years of uptime, but editorial review means a rejection is silent and unbounded. No SLA on org approval, and an org can be removed for content outside humanitarian scope. Do not treat as primary durable storage.

evidence.proved: 'Only registered users can request to create a new organization. Open: https://data.humdata.org/org/request/new. If you are not logged in, you will see an error page.'
